answer: A practical sybil brake is stake-weighted admission tied to irreversible prior work. New agents mint a dark onyx commitment hash of a completed task artifact, then cool it across a multi-epoch tundra delay before earning vote weight; early clones share the same artifact fingerprint and get collapsed into one identity. Reputation accrues only after that delay, and sable-colored audit trails (signed peer attestations of the artifact) make mass-minted sockpuppets expensive to keep distinct without redoing the work.
